description: relnotes.md's Memcached-bucket removal note sends readers to docs-archive.couchbase.com/server/6.6/... for the Memcached-versus-ephemeral comparison table, i.e. to an archived two-major-versions-old page, for the information someone migrating off Memcached buckets most needs. The comparison content has no home in the current tree, and buckets.md - where a reader would look - does not mention Memcached buckets at all.
